name: Kraan Consistent Product Grid Height for WooCommerce
author: marcelkraan

sections.description:
Kraan Consistent Product Grid Height for WooCommerce keeps WooCommerce product grids visually aligned.

Features:
* Equal height product cards per row across desktop and mobile.
* Configurable mobile columns (choose 1, 2, 3, or 4 columns under settings).
* Fully neutralizes Enfold theme 4-column slider compressions on small screens.
* Strict millimeter-exact height alignment using title clamping (-webkit-line-clamp: 2).
* Harmonized 1:1 square image aspect ratios.
* Add to Cart buttons pinned to the bottom of every card.
* Card styling: Custom background colors, border width, border color, border radius, and padding.
* Modern hover effects: Lift animation, configurable lift distance, and shadow opacity percentage.
* Optional removal of sale badges.
* Optional removal of review stars.
* Deep integration and fix for Enfold theme (Avia Layout Builder product slider & inner_product containers).
* Full support for classic WooCommerce loops and WooCommerce Blocks.
* No external JavaScript and no tracking.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Consistent Product Grid.
  4. Save your preferred settings.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Added Mobile Grid Columns setting: allows selecting 1, 2, 3, or 4 columns on mobile screens.
  • Dynamic calculation of flex item widths and gaps for mobile viewports (< 989px).

1.3.0

  • Fix: Overrode Enfold responsive breakpoints (< 989px) to prevent 4-column slider slide-entry compression on mobile.
  • Enforced flex-wrap on .slide-entry-wrap and .avia-slideshow-inner.
  • Locked 2-line title height and 1:1 aspect ratio for pixel-exact equal height rows.

1.2.0

  • Removed Text Domain and load_plugin_textdomain() to rely on automatic WP.org translations.
  • Refactored code to meet strict WordPress Coding Standards.

1.1.0

  • Added styling options for card background, border radius, padding, hover lift, and shadow intensity.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
